message: <input type="text" name="last"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
<input> can’t be inside <label>, which already labels <input> at 1:13; a label contains only the control it labels.
<input type="text" id="other"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
<input> can’t be inside <label for="email">, which labels another control; a label contains only the control it labels.
<label> can’t be inside <label>, which must not contain <label> elements.
